## Why it made the list

A move-in-ready villa in Lyderslev on Stevns with three bedrooms, a living room and kitchen together as the heart of the house, and open views over the fields to Lyderslev Church. Quiet village setting, 87 m² on a 279 m² plot that is easy to look after. 695,000 kr., about a third below the price per m² of the Store Heddinge area. Copenhagen is about 1 h 13 by car.

## Is €93,200 a good price for this home?

At about €1,071 per m², this home is 36% above the median for Denmark on RealHunt (€790 per m², across 44 homes checked by a person). 7 of those homes cost more per m².

Asking prices are what the seller asks, not what homes sell for. Compare with recent sales in the same village before you make an offer.

## What it costs to buy this home

Buying in Denmark adds about 1.5-3% in taxes and fees on top of the price: roughly €1,398 to €2,796 here, so plan for about €94,598 to €95,996 in total.

Registration fee on the deed (tinglysningsafgift) of DKK 1,850 plus 0.6% of the price, about 1% for a buyer's lawyer, and, if you borrow, a mortgage registration fee of DKK 1,825 plus 1.25% of the loan; the seller normally pays the agent.

Every year: Owners pay property value tax (ejendomsværdiskat) of 0.51% on 80% of the official valuation (1.4% above DKK 9.2 million) plus municipal land tax (grundskyld) at a rate set by each municipality, capped at 30 per mille of the land value.

General information, not tax advice: ask a local lawyer or notary for the exact figure.

The home is in Lyderslev, Stevns, Denmark.

The nearest airport is about 36 km away (Copenhagen Roskilde Airport). Distances are in a straight line.

Not stated: the listing gives neither a community fee nor a yearly property tax. Ask the agent for both before you make an offer.
